enriched_activities.desc: Lie on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Place hand under pillow. Turn to right side. Stretch legs. Pull blanket up to chin. Turn onto back. Place arms by side. Breathe deeply. Turn to left side again. Adjust pillow. Continue sleeping.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Spit in sink. Turn off tap. Pick up face wash. Apply to face. Rinse face. Pick up towel. Dry face. Pick up comb. Comb hair. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and reviewing daily reminders
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open wardrobe. Pick up shirt. Put on shirt. Pick up pants. Put on pants. Pick up socks. Put on socks. Pick up shoes. Put on shoes. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open calendar app. Check reminders. Scroll through tasks. Close phone. Place phone on desk. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast (oatmeal and tea)
enriched_activities.desc: Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open cupboard. Take out oatmeal. Take out pot. Fill pot with water. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Stir oatmeal. Pour oatmeal into bowl. Add milk. Pick up spoon. Eat oatmeal. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Pour boiling water into cup. Add tea bag. Drink tea. Wash bowl and spoon. Turn off stove.

Scrape food scraps into bin. Fill sink with water. Add dish soap. Pick up sponge. Wash dishes. Rinse dishes. Place dishes on drying rack. Drain sink. Wipe counter with cloth. Put away clean dishes. Wipe stove. Sweep floor. Empty bin. Replace bin liner. Turn off light. Walk out of kitchen.

Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Sort clothes into pile. Pick up clothes. Place clothes into washing machine. Add detergent. Close washing machine door. Press power button. Select wash cycle. Press start button. Wait for machine to start. Check machine is running. Walk out of bathroom.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Log in. Open online course portal. Open textbook. Read chapter. Highlight key points. Take notes in notebook. Type notes on laptop. Pause to stretch. Continue reading. Write summary. Close textbook. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Walk to kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Grocery shopping at local market (walking/bus, paying cash, sticking to budget)
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up reusable bags. Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare with cash. Get off bus. Walk to market. Pick up basket. Select vegetables. Check prices. Select fruit. Select bread. Select milk. Go to checkout. Pay cash. Receive change. Place items in bags. Carry bags to bus stop. Board bus. Walk home.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Chop vegetables. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Add oil. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Place food on plate. Pick up fork. Eat lunch. Wash plate and fork. Turn off light.

Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open laptop. Open assignment file. Read instructions. Type outline. Open textbook. Find references. Write paragraphs. Check word count. Save document. Close laptop. Turn off desk lamp. Walk to bathroom.

Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Take out clothes. Shake each item. Pick up hangers. Hang clothes on rack. Hang clothes on line. Adjust clothes. Close washing machine door. Pick up empty basket. Walk to bedroom. Place basket in closet.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure time (looking at photo of family dog)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open gallery app. Scroll to photo. Look at photo. Zoom in. Smile. Swipe to next photo. Look at another photo. Close gallery. Place phone on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to animal shelter (walking/bus, no EV use)
enriched_activities.desc: Pick up bag. Walk to bus stop. Check bus timetable. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare with cash. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk to animal shelter. Enter shelter.

Enter shelter. Greet staff. Put on apron. Pick up food bowls. Fill bowls with food. Place bowls in cages. Open cages. Clean cages. Replace bedding. Refill water bowls. Pick up leash. Take dog for walk. Return dog to cage. Pick up cat. Brush cat. Return cat to cage. Remove apron. Wash hands. Say goodbye to staff. Walk out.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting home from animal shelter (walking/bus, no EV use)
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Check phone for messages. Wait for bus. Board bus. Pay fare with cash. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Get off bus. Walk home. Enter house. Remove shoes.

Enter kitchen. Turn on light. Open refrigerator. Take out ingredients. Close refrigerator. Take out cutting board. Chop vegetables. Take out pot. Fill pot with water. Place pot on stove. Turn on stove. Add pasta. Stir. Drain pasta. Add sauce. Place food on plate. Pick up fork. Eat dinner. Wash plate and fork. Turn off light.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing day, checking messages, planning week ahead
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit at desk. Turn on desk lamp. Open planner. Write down tasks completed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Open messages. Read messages. Reply to messages. Open calendar. Check upcoming appointments. Write appointments in planner. Close planner. Close phone. Turn off desk lamp. Walk to bathroom.

Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower and adjust temperature. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Wash body. Rinse body. Apply shampoo. Wash hair. Rinse hair. Turn off shower. Step out and pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Pick up toothbrush and apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Turn off light. Walk to bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Winding down with tea, reading, setting alarms and reminders
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to kitchen. Fill kettle with water. Turn on kettle. Take out teacup. Place tea bag in cup. Pour boiling water into cup. Pick up cup. Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Open book. Read pages. Drink tea. Place cup on bedside table. Pick up phone. Set alarm for morning. Set reminders. Close phone. Close book. Turn off light. Lie down.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Turn to right side. Place hand on pillow. Breathe slowly. Turn to back. Adjust blanket. Turn to left side. Bend knees. Breathe deeply. Turn to right side. Pull blanket up. Place arm under pillow. Continue sleeping.
